assets.label: Toronto skyline waterfront sketch
assets.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: Large transparent background illustration for the who-we-are section
Primary request: Generate a new standalone transparent black-and-gray editorial ink engraving of the Toronto waterfront skyline, centered on the CN Tower and Rogers Centre, with low-rise and high-rise buildings, small sailboats on Lake Ontario, stippled clouds, water reflections, and a refined financial-services print texture. Match the reference crop's wide composition and delicate line weight. Remove all website typography, cards, UI rules, borders, green accent marks, and page texture. Keep the artwork monochrome graphite/charcoal linework on a transparent background.
Input images: the crop is a reference image only. Generate a brand-new standalone asset; do not copy crop pixels.
Composition/framing: match the reference crop's subject, angle, aspect ratio, and visual weight.
Constraints: remove neighboring-page contamination, occluding unrelated assets, webpage framing, and collage leftovers.
Transparency/background: Generate on a perfectly flat solid #00ff00 chroma-key background for later alpha removal; do not use #00ff00 in the subject.
Avoid: crop output, screenshot, full page mockup, browser frame, watermark, placeholder, unrelated typography.
assets.negative_prompt: No page screenshot, no text, no UI cards, no labels, no browser chrome, no colored accents, no filled white rectangle, no photorealism, no watermark.
